final_note: Euclid's algorithm: gcd(a, b) = gcd(b, a mod b)!

concepts.def: a | b means b = ka for some integer k.
Greatest common divisor of a and b.
gcd(a, b) = gcd(b, a mod b).
gcd(a, b) = sa + tb for some integers s, t.
x^2 = c_1 x + c_2 gives general solution.
